paragraphs: Rav Shmuel bar Aha, to Rav Pappa: Nazir 51b. Before Rav Pappa, in Rava bar Ulla's name: Menahot 34a; Hullin 91a. In Bava Kamma 99a: “Shmuel bar Aha said.” Tosafot, Bava Metzia 112, end of side a, quote it as “Rav Ashi bar Hama said”—certainly a scribal error.
